page: Microsoft Azure NV6ads_A10_v5 is an entry-tier GPU-accelerated virtual machine from the NVADSA10v5 series, tailored for workloads requiring dedicated graphic processing without the cost of a full physical accelerator. Powered by an AMD x86_64 processor managed through Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 6 dedicated vCPUs alongside 55.0 GB of system memory, delivering a generous allocation of 9.17 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU partition representing approximately one-sixth of the physical card, delivering 4 GB of dedicated video memory. In addition to GPU capabilities, the instance includes 193 GB of local SSD storage to support temporary files, caching, and operating system scratch space.

The primary architectural tradeoff is the constrained 4 GB frame buffer, which limits the instance from hosting large language models or memory-intensive rendering pipelines. Qualitatively, sharing an enterprise-grade NVIDIA A10 GPU across virtual partitions makes this instance cost-effective for tasks that only require modest acceleration. The NV6ads_A10_v5 is best suited for virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), light computer-aided design (CAD), entry-level AI inference, video encoding, and graphical interactive workstations.
description: Microsoft Azure NV6ads_A10_v5 is a specialized virtual machine within the NVADSA10v5 family designed for entry-level graphics and hardware-accelerated workloads. Driven by an AMD x86_64 processor under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance provides 6 dedicated vCPUs alongside 55.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 9.17 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU offering 4 GB of dedicated VRAM, representing one-sixth of a full accelerator. Storage needs are accommodated by an included 193 GB local SSD, supporting workloads with temporary high-speed scratch space requirements. By partitioning GPU resources, the instance achieves high qualitative cost efficiency for users who require hardware acceleration without the overhead of provisioning a dedicated full GPU. However, the 4 GB VRAM ceiling restricts deployment of large neural models. The NV6ads_A10_v5 is well suited for virtual desktop infrastructure, light computer-aided design, exploratory machine learning inference, and video encoding.
